title: Heptabase Updates - Gallery, New Design for the Right Sidebar, Whiteboard Toolbar, Whiteboard Live Public Link, and more!
summary: Heptabase Updates - Gallery, New Design for the Right Sidebar, Whiteboard Toolbar, Whiteboard Live Public Link, and more!
body_markdown:
Dear Heptabase User,


One of the most common requests we hear from new users in their first week is: “Can I see how others are using Heptabase for learning, research, and planning?”


That’s why we’re building the[**Gallery](https://heptabase.com/gallery) ** — a dedicated space to explore whiteboards published by our community.


If you’d like to share how you use Heptabase, simply publish your whiteboard and click the “Submit your whiteboard” button in the[Gallery](https://heptabase.com/gallery) . Our team will review your submission within 1–3 business days and let you know if it’s approved or needs revision.


The Gallery is **coming soon** , and we can’t wait to show you how other users are using Heptabase!


---


### Right Sidebar & Side Panel: New design​


We’ve redesigned our right sidebar and side panel in the latest version. You can now open Chat, Card Library, and Journal from anywhere.


When you open the Card Library in the sidebar, you can also click on cards to view them directly in the side panel as a handy reference!


### Whiteboard: Toolbar​


In the latest version, we've introduced a new toolbar on the whiteboard, making it easier to use different tools. We've also changed some tool shortcuts—just hover over the toolbar to see them.


### App: Live public link​


In the latest version, you can now create a live public link for your whiteboard. Anyone with the link will always see the most up-to-date content as you make changes.


For more information, please check out our tutorial:[How do I publish whiteboards with a public link?](http://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/12121546)


---


### Heptabase Related Contents​


In this video, Professor Forrest Perry (FP) shows how he creates and organizes lesson plans using Heptabase. He highlights a key feature: cards can appear on multiple whiteboards as "replicants." FP also shows how this feature helped him solve a specific problem. We recommend checking out FP’s insights!

---


We hope that these updates will improve your experience on Heptabase and make your learning easier and more enjoyable.


If you have any feedback or suggestions, or you want to share your use cases or contents related to Heptabase, please don't hesitate to chat with us through our[in app support](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10448156-how-can-i-contact-heptabase-support) .


Stay tuned for future updates, and we hope you have a great day!


Best regards,


Heptabase Team
